plugins.description: Local, deliberately exaggerated weather: occasional rain that targets one specific lane of city-layout's 3-lane bypass, plus the shared simulated clock (city_hour) and time-speed control that drives resident behavior like the morning bakery rush.
plugins.author: prackoreal

plugins.description: Reads city-layout's road graph and city-weather's zones, then answers 'how do I get there' for residents purely through Attributes — a resident sets desired_destination on itself, this plugin computes a path (weighing live congestion and bad weather) and writes route back. No direct calls between plugins, just Core relay.
plugins.author: prackoreal

plugins.description: 20 residents, each with a home. Decides when to head to a bakery, restaurant, school or park based on city-weather's clock, asks city-routing how to get there, and walks the returned route, speeding up or pausing with the same clock's time-speed control. Requires a Layout source (spy-loader, or a .spy import) and city-routing to already be running.
plugins.author: prackoreal

plugins.description: Broadcasts a multiple-choice question and tallies live answers. Now with adaptive per-student difficulty (off by default; teacher-toggleable automatic/manual), a correctness streak and opt-in scoreboard per student, and live mid-session editing (replace the current question, skip ahead, or extend the timer) via a teacher_command control attribute. No real teacher UI yet -- all of this is driven by attributes for now. Install math-student alongside it to see the tally move.
plugins.author: prackoreal

plugins.description: One simulated student in a math-teacher class: watches its assigned question (tiered if the teacher's adaptive difficulty is on) and answers after a short random 'thinking' delay, standing in for a real student clicking an option until there's a real UI for it. Also reads its own streak and the class scoreboard when the teacher enables it. Install several instances to populate math-teacher's live tally.
plugins.author: prackoreal

plugins.description: Drag this in like any other plugin, then drag a .spy file (imported earlier through the Files panel) onto its own canvas widget to load it. Publishes into the Core using the exact same attribute vocabulary the city plugins already use, so city-weather, city-routing, and city-residents recognize its buildings and roads with zero changes to any of them. Loading is additive — feed it several files over its lifetime, unplugging it despawns everything it ever loaded, in one action, same as any other plugin.
plugins.author: prackoreal

packages.name: city
packages.description: The whole city simulation in one download: a layout source, weather and a shared clock, routing, and the residents who actually walk around and react to all three. Installs all four; they land on the canvas already grouped together, like puzzle pieces — drag one out of the group to switch it off without deleting it, drag it back in to reactivate it.

packages.name: Math Plugin
packages.description: A teacher broadcasts multiple-choice questions (with adaptive per-student difficulty, streaks, an opt-in scoreboard, and live mid-session editing), students answer, a live tally shows on screen. Installs both math-teacher and math-student; they land on the canvas already grouped as one block.
